evan: Quick design huddle: we keep seeing confusion around cross-project service calls. I want a clear "scope cartography" model: prefer single-scope tokens for data-plane, and explicit multi-scope broker tokens only when necessary. Thoughts?

kira: Agree. Single-scope by default reduces surprise. For sync jobs that touch many projects, broker mints a short-lived multi-scope token with an explicit `scopes` list. Keep multi-scope rare. :+1:

omar: Runtime perf note: hot path must be O(1). Token shape for data-plane svc_token should include: sub, iss, exp, caps[], scope_kind, scope_id, gen. No heavy role graph.

ev an: typo ;)

evan: oops. fixed.

kira: Example svc_token (compact):
```json
{"sub":"svc:sync-7","iss":"rdwd-auth","exp":1720000000,"caps":["obj:read","obj:write"],"scope_kind":"project","scope_id":"proj_abc","gen":3}
```

omar: For multi-scope broker tokens: include `scopes:["proj_a","proj_b"]` and hard cap N scopes (e.g., 8). For anything >N, require orchestration to break into per-scope calls.

kira: Migration: detect keys with machine-like usage; console will recommend rotating to svc_token. Soft enforcement: add `x-rdwd-scope` header for opt-in routes during beta.

evan: Revocation: short TTL + per-subject generation number. On emergency revoke increase gen; runtime compares token.gen <= cached_gen ? deny. We'll keep revocation cache per subject in memory.

omar: Delegation: allow `on_behalf_of` only via broker with single-use delegated token (nonce + 1-2m TTL). Broker stores nonce and rejects reuse.

kira: Audit: log mint event with actor, source_role, caps projection, and mapping id. Retain 1y for partner-related mints, 90d for internal.

evan: Telemetry: token_type, scope_kind, caps_count, validation_latency_ms, gen_mismatch_rate. Alert if gen_mismatch spikes.

omar: Edge-case: cross-tenant proxying (service receives request forwarded for another org). Disallow unless proxy proves original auth via sealed_claim or pof. We'll document this as "forbidden by default" and require explicit broker approval.

kira: Action items:
- @omar: prototype validator lib (local JWKS + gen cache) ETA 2w
- @kira: migration heuristics + console text ETA 4d
- @evan: capture scope cartography section in the impending auth RFC ETA 1w

evan: Cool — I'll draft the RFC section and include sample header examples and a compact policy table. Drop any oddball cases here (partner pools, billing-only scopes, huge-sync jobs).
